case_number: 2025 INSC 433; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. _________ OF 2025 @ SLP(CRL) NO.8403 OF 2024

parties.respondent: The State of Haryana and Ors.

summary: CBI investigation ordered by High Court set aside; impugned order dated 17.05.2024 reversed; parameters for CBI probe not met; allegations against local police unsubstantiated; investigation returned to Haryana police; contempt petition dismissed after CBI apology for registering FIR during stay; no abuse of process found in reversion.
legal_provisions_cited: State of W.B. v. Committee for Protection of Democratic Rights, (2010) 3 SCC 571
Minor Irrigation & Rural Engg. Services, U.P. v. Sahngoo Ram Arya, (2002) 5 SCC 521
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order dated 17.05.2024 setting up CBI investigation set aside; investigation reverted to Haryana police; contempt petition dismissed.
